issues.detail: The Greek 'παραγενομενος τις των αδελφων' implies 'having come from the brothers' (or a messenger from the brothers). The Vietnamese translation 'cũng chẳng có anh em nào đến' (no brothers came) changes the subject/agent of the action. The Greek suggests that no one *from* the brothers arrived to report, rather than stating that no brothers arrived at all.
